02833 choshen {kho'-shen}

字根已不使用, 其意可能為"包含"或"閃耀"; TWOT - 772a; 陽性名詞

AV - breastplate 25; 25

1) 胸牌
   1a) 大祭司所穿的袍子上的口袋, 用來裝烏陵和土明之用

from an unused root probably meaning to contain or sparkle;

1) breastplate, breastpiece
